title: Webb captures detailed beauty of Ring Nebula (MIRI image)

evidence.locator: 1257 x 1015 px over 2.33 × 1.88 arcmin; MIRI 5.6, 7.7, 10, 11, 12, 15, 18, 21 and 25 µm; released 21 August 2023. The file's embedded sky tags for scale and direction, 0.1111 arcsec per pixel and north 132.9° right of vertical, and the star for place: the central star in the picture, pixel 627.5, 513.5, is set at the place the Ring Nebula's page stands at, so the frame's centre is 283.396433°, 33.0290199°. The tags alone put the star 0.04 arcsec from where the picture shows it.
